integrity: The proof is self-contained. The finite checks use exact arithmetic and exhaustive enumeration. The closest recent source establishes existence and notes non-uniqueness but does not state the multiplicity formulas. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts only ordered nilpotent–involution factorizations of rank-one matrices in \(M_3(\mathbb F_q)\). It does not cover rank two, nilpotent–idempotent multiplicities, or higher dimensions. Exact replay was performed only for \(q=2,3,4\); the all-\(q\) statement is proved combinatorially.
title: Exact rank-one multiplicities for nilpotent–involution factorizations in \(M_3(\mathbb F_q)\)
